title: Entangled Logistics
description: Two particles, one state - and so one channel. Unlocks Entangled Relays, Transceivers and the Entanglement Tuner.

puzzle.goal: Alice measures one particle of an entangled pair with one of two settings A or X; Bob measures the other with B or Y. Each outcome is ±1. Combine the four expectation values of the products of outcomes into the single correlation quantity that any local classical model keeps between −2 and 2.
puzzle.name: CHSH inequality (Bell test)
puzzle.form: avg ( A * B ) - avg ( A * Y ) + avg ( X * B ) + avg ( X * Y )
puzzle.ask: With optimal settings a pure entangled state reaches 2√2; a noisy (Werner) state of visibility V reaches 2√2·V. Find S for the visibility below.
puzzle.method: Classically each outcome is fixed in advance, so A(B − Y) + X(B + Y) is always ±2. Average each product separately; exactly one of the four terms enters with the opposite sign.
